ImageDescription.value:
The Director of PricewaterhouseCoopers Ukraine (PwC), Dmitriy Grinchishin, at the online broadcast of Teletriumph 2013. PwC was the independent auditor of the Teletriumphs, the national television awards of Ukraine. At the time, PwC was also the independent auditor of the Oscars.

PwC has since been involved in multiple scandals in Ukraine, including cases involving bribery, embezzlement, and hiding Russian oligarch assets around the Mediterranean.
